stage.noWebgpuBody: This browser has no WebGPU adapter: the scenes are off, the crowd still dances. Use Chrome 113+, Edge, Firefox 141+ or Safari 26+ on a machine with a GPU.
stage.followHint: Choose scenes within the current category from the on-air section; your pick stays until the next section.
stage.crowdCharacterHint: Choose a character for this scene. They dance to the beat and settle with the music.
stage.photosensitiveHint: No flashes or strobes; luminance never jumps.
stage.connect.title: Stage not connected
stage.connect.body: This window has no session. Open the Stage from the console, connect to the last session, or run the demo signal.
scene.desc.intro-lines: An ocean of silver light particles; bass lifts the waves, kicks send ripples, and breaks calm the surface.
scene.desc.build-rise: Six fixed blue beams from ceiling to floor, unevenly spaced, with a soft glow and slow staggered fades.
scene.desc.drop-burst: A galaxy of particles orbiting the crossfader point in 3-D: kicks send a shockwave ring through the disc, bass tightens the orbits, hats sparkle, the drop blows it into a sphere and it collapses back.
scene.desc.break-haze: Ink feedback with beat-synced zoom and phrase symmetry; kicks inject colour.
scene.desc.body-pulse: A raymarched solid that morphs each phrase; bass is mass, mids are cavities, a LOW kill drops the floor.
scene.desc.blackout: Black output. Restore with the same button or Shift+B.
stage.crowdHint: Adds the dancing crowd to the scene on screen only; other scenes stay as they are (C).
scene.desc.waves: Glowing lines carry the spectrum as waves; kicks ripple from the crossfader point, snares flash alternate lines, the drop spikes them all.
scene.desc.cubes: 512 cubes assemble into a grid, a helix, a sphere and a lattice — one per phrase — swell on kicks, spin on beats and burst apart on the drop.
scene.desc.face: An expressive face: it nods on the beat, blinks on snares, follows the crossfader with its eyes, opens its mouth with the bass and raises its brows through the build.
stage.lowerThirdHint: Shows the title, artist, key and tempo for six seconds when a track goes on air (N).
stage.eventNameHint: Shown under the clock while the Stage is idle. Up to 40 characters.
stage.presetFull: Nine presets is the limit — delete one first.
stage.presetEmpty: No presets yet. Set the look you like, then save it.
stage.morphHint: The Kick Field's particles assemble into this word at the next phrase and let go on the drop (M). Type heart, star or mark for a shape.
stage.nightSkyHint: One star per track played, in its own key colour, joined in the order they went on air.
stage.crowdFitHint: Saved for this scene. The formation fits the output so everyone stays visible.
stage.categoryHint: Blend within a category. Switching categories uses a cut.
scene.desc.line-waves: Fine flowing waves; the music gently lifts and folds the lines.
scene.desc.line-orbits: Nested elliptical rings that slowly turn and breathe with the bass.
scene.desc.line-ribbons: A woven ribbon of fine lines; smooth curves open with the music.
scene.desc.line-lattice: A rippling line grid with gentle motion and a quiet colour gradient.
stage.cinematicHint: Four worlds. One control. Smooth response to your music.
stage.controlsHint: One intensity control for motion and musical response.
scene.desc.cinematic-phoenix: A celestial phoenix lifts its wings above a moonlit temple. Bass carries the feathers; embers rise gently.
scene.desc.cinematic-gate: A jeweled mandala turns inside an alien garden. Layered orbits open with the bass, without flashes.
scene.desc.cinematic-lotus: An opal lotus breathes over a midnight lake. Petals unfurl with the music as ripples cross its reflection.
scene.desc.cinematic-crystal: Travel through a deep crystal corridor. Amber filaments and drifting shards follow the music.
